The script drops head 6 (`DROP_HEAD = 6`), removing rows and columns `768..895`, but the specification's "Required result" requires removing head 5, keeping rows `0..639` and `768..2047` (clauses 1 through 4). As a result every q, k, v and o projection in all 16 layers keeps the wrong slice, so the values will not be bit-exact against the reference even though the shape checks pass.

note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
